main_text.p: tem Sanctorum in lumine, & quibus in tenebris & umbra mortis sedentib. Christus illucescit: alia eorum qui in tenebris & peccatis suis male pereunt, nunquam eos respiciente Christo, in quo electi non erant antequam iacta essent mundi fundamenta.
main_text.head: VERSVS IX.

p.i: Ego vero cum voce laudis sacrificabo tibi, & quae vovi reddam. Salus est Iehovae.

At ego palam, editaque voce, potetiam & bonitatem tuam singularem depraedicans, sacrificia tibi voti reus persoluam. Tu siquidem unus, ut ex meo unius exemplo satis superque constat, servare quoscunque libuit potes.

main_text.head: SYLLOGISMVS
main_text.p: Seruatori offerenda sunt σωτήρια, summa cum gratitudine, & quidem publice priuatimque. Atqui Iehouah Deus noster Seruator est: & eius solius proprium est, seruare fideles suos ipsius opem implorantes. Quare ei σωτήρια offerenda sunt.

page.notes: Greek headings and words are transcribed in Greek letters as printed; the Greek on "τῆς λέξεως" and the word "Παραφρασις" are read from small type and may be imperfect. The Greek "σωτήρια" appears in italic and is reproduced as printed. The catchword "SYLLO-" is a catchword at the foot of the page, shown in the text as a hyphenated fragment; it is a signature-line word and not part of the running text. The section headings were classed as level 2 as parts within the commentary on Jonah chapter II.
